capabilities: Insert an "On this day" code block into a daily note or template
Render same-day entries from earlier years as folded cards, newest first
Open the prior year's note from a card's arrow button
Skip front matter, nested blocks, and headings when rendering old entries
Configure date format, folder scope, and auto-expansion of the newest card
extras: The manifest description states the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Daily notes only surface the current day, so revisiting what you wrote on this date in past years requires searching by hand.
summary: Daily-note companion that shows entries from the same calendar day in earlier years as folding cards embedded via a code block.
